verdict.rationale: Grok Build is itself a coding agent, and its docs extensively cover delegating work to it. Users can hand off tasks in the TUI, have it plan before editing, and let it track todos. It can spawn subagents with their own context, run background tasks and recurring /loop jobs, and report status for every session on a dashboard. Community users corroborate it in hands-on terms ('harness is butter smooth', 'impressive performance in a couple of my projects'). Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports specifically exercising the delegation features (subagents, background tasks, plan mode) rather than general praise.
